label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to target variable, then to InetAddress.getByName(target) for DNS resolution, and finally to URL construction at line 24 ('http://' + target + '/api'). The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input. Although loopback/site-local checks exist, they do not mitigate SSRF risks from external/internal IP enumeration, IPv6 bypasses, DNS rebinding, or metadata endpoint attacks. The vulnerable path allows direct user control over outbound destination.

evidence.note: User input param -> target -> DNS resolve -> URL openStream; sink at L24 uses unvalidated target
